offering_description.value: EPAM designs, builds and modernizes custom software and digital platforms for enterprises and public-sector organizations. Its global delivery teams combine technology consulting, product design and engineering, and ongoing operation of applications and cloud infrastructure.

primary_services.value: Custom software engineering; cloud and application modernization; technology and business consulting; digital product design; managed application and infrastructure services

customer_segment.value: B2B: Large enterprises, including banks, software companies, retailers and life sciences companies; B2G: Government departments and public-sector agencies modernizing digital services

end_markets.value: Financial services; software and technology; retail and consumer goods; media and telecommunications; life sciences and healthcare

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Engineering, modernization and consulting engagements billed on a time-and-materials or fixed-price basis; service fees: Ongoing operation and maintenance of applications and cloud infrastructure

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Combines engineering talent and client technology to build and operate software for enterprises and government agencies; software / platform: Integrates AI models and enterprise data through orchestration software for corporate technology teams

geography_served.value: global: Serves North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific, with delivery operations also in Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Software engineering, technology consulting, digital design, cloud modernization and managed IT services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise account teams sell directly to clients; partners / resellers: Cloud and enterprise software partners collaborate on customer engagements

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Client data processing is subject to GDPR and other applicable privacy and data protection rules

notes: The extent of standalone software sales is uncertain.
